visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a nostalgic montage of a young couple; a man wearing a red backpack and a woman in a black bucket hat and black coat stand against a textured grey corrugated roof, followed by a bright shot of them posing together on a sunlit railway track with various background pedestrians and tropical greenery. (2) The scene shifts to the woman in an indoor setting, wearing glasses and a black shirt inside a rustic vegetarian deli with wooden furniture, then transitions to the man standing outside a modern shop window while checking his smartphone, wearing a white t-shirt and black tactical vest. (3) High-definition close-ups of food preparation are featured, showcasing steaming bowls of vegetarian noodles with colorful garnishes like carrots and greens, followed by the couple smiling warmly while holding their published physical book titled '找蔬食' in a brightly lit indoor space. (4) A travel sequence shows the woman eating outdoors at a windy harbor pier with sea water in the background, the man slurping noodles in a crowded ramen shop, and the pair walking through a sleek, modern airport terminal with Adidas-branded suitcases and overhead flight information displays. (5) The focus intensifies on food textures with macro shots of 7-Eleven 'Tian Su Di Shu' meal boxes being opened, thick brown sauce being poured over rice and plant-based beef chunks, and slices of vegetarian pizza with stretchy melted cheese being lifted to show the crust. (6) A vibrant green promotional graphic covers the screen detailing Earth Day offers and OpenPoint rewards with small product icons at the bottom, concluding with the couple walking away from a brightly lit 7-Eleven storefront at night, laughing and holding cold beverages.
